fields.label: Company Logo
fields.description: Logo shown on website pages, portals, and emails.

fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: The parent company / brand name shown on the website and portals.

fields.label: Website Tagline
fields.description: Short tagline shown in the website hero and footer (e.g. 'Business Software Built Right')

fields.label: Founder Name
fields.description: Name shown on the About and Home pages

fields.label: Allow Application Creation By Website User
fields.description: When enabled, the Get Started / Start Free Trial buttons and registration form are shown on the subscription page so website visitors can self-provision a clinic application.

fields.label: Enable Subscription Enforcement (block login on expiry)
Suspension Mode
fields.description: Soft Block: blocks login only. Hard Suspend: puts site in maintenance mode (offline).

fields.label: Auto-Suspend When Trial Expires
fields.description: Automatically suspend the site when the trial period ends and subscription is not activated.

fields.label: Auto-Suspend When Subscription Expires
fields.description: Automatically suspend the site when the paid subscription ends (after grace period).

fields.label: Bank Account Details
fields.description: Shown to customers on the payment page

fields.label: Send Welcome Email After Site Creation
fields.description: When enabled, sends an email with site URL and credentials to new clinics after provisioning.

fields.label: Sender Email
fields.description: From address for all outgoing emails

fields.label: Send Renewal Reminder Emails
fields.description: Automatically email customers before their subscription expires.

fields.label: Reminder Days Before Expiry
fields.description: Comma-separated days before expiry to send reminder emails. e.g. 7,3,1

fields.label: Base Domain
fields.description: e.g. prescriptionhub.com (without https://)

fields.label: Master Site Name
fields.description: Full site name of the master site to clone from

fields.label: SSL Certificate Path
fields.description: Full path to the SSL certificate (.pem) file. Written to site_config.json on site creation.

fields.label: SSL Certificate Key Path
fields.description: Full path to the SSL certificate key file. Written to site_config.json on site creation.

fields.label: Enable Live Site Ping (Online/Offline Check)
fields.description: Shows live online/offline status for each site in the Control Room. Disable if it causes performance issues.

fields.label: Ping Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a ping response before marking site as offline

fields.label: Enable Email OTP Verification on Registration
fields.description: When enabled, users must verify their email address via a one-time code sent to their inbox before completing registration. Uses the configured outgoing email server — no third-party service required.

fields.label: Enable Phone OTP Verification on Registration
fields.description: When enabled, users must verify their phone number via a one-time SMS code (sent through MSG91) before completing registration.

fields.label: MSG91 Auth Key
fields.description: Your MSG91 account auth key. Found in MSG91 dashboard → API → Auth Key.

fields.label: MSG91 OTP Template ID
fields.description: The approved OTP template ID from your MSG91 account. The template must contain ##OTP## as the variable.

fields.label: Sender ID
fields.description: 6-character alphanumeric sender ID registered with MSG91 (e.g. OTPSMS).
